categories.main_business_segments: Novoray Corporation primarily engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of functional inorganic non-metallic powder materials, focusing on silicon-based and aluminum-based oxides. Its products serve semiconductor packaging materials, electronic circuit substrates, thermal interface materials, adhesives, honeycomb ceramics, 3D printing, dental materials, and other emerging fields. The company also operates subsidiaries involved in producing spherical powders and liquid fillers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced grinding, flame fusion, high-temperature oxidation, liquid phase synthesis, and surface modification technologies to produce micron, submicron, and nano-sized spherical and angular powders. It has proprietary technologies in particle design, high-temperature spheroidization, phase control, dispersion, and simulation. Manufacturing includes intelligent automated production lines with ISO certifications, emphasizing low cut-off points, low dielectric loss, high purity, and high thermal conductivity.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading enterprises in semiconductor packaging materials (EMC, LMC, GMC, UF), high-frequency and high-speed copper clad laminates, thermal interface materials, adhesives, advanced insulation products, honeycomb ceramics, 3D printing, and dental materials. The company serves industries such as AI servers, high-speed communications, consumer electronics, automotive electronics, aerospace, and new energy vehicles. Customers are located in Mainland China, Japan, South Korea, Europe, Southeast Asia, and Taiwan.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing in Lianyungang, Jiangsu Province. It has expanded sales to international markets including Japan, South Korea, Europe, Southeast Asia, and Taiwan. It also has a wholly-owned subsidiary in Hong Kong for trade operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Novoray operates upstream and midstream in the supply chain as a producer of advanced functional inorganic non-metallic powder materials that serve as critical raw materials and fillers for downstream semiconductor packaging, electronic substrates, and thermal management materials manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in advanced semiconductor packaging materials, high-frequency and high-speed substrates, and high thermal conductivity materials for new energy vehicles. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on particle design, surface modification, and synthesis technologies. Strategic initiatives include building a national-level R&D center, expanding product categories, and integrating digital transformation with SAP and AI-driven customer demand forecasting.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of functional inorganic non-metallic powder materials and related products. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by agency sales, with pricing and procurement closely aligned to customer orders and market conditions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Novoray is a leading domestic player and recognized as a national high-tech enterprise and 'Little Giant' specialized company in China. It holds a dominant position in the functional inorganic non-metallic powder materials sector, with strong technological barriers and brand recognition. It competes with both domestic and international suppliers in semiconductor packaging and electronic materials markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 960 million, a 34.94% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 251 million, up 44.47%. It maintains a strong growth trajectory supported by expanding high-end product sales and increased R&D investment, with total assets nearing RMB 2 billion and equity of RMB 1.5 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Novoray offers high-purity, low dielectric loss, low radioactivity, and high thermal conductivity spherical powders tailored for advanced semiconductor packaging and high-frequency substrates. Its products enable higher chip integration, improved thermal management, and enhanced reliability. The company differentiates through proprietary technologies, comprehensive product lines, and integrated customer service, positioning itself as a trusted partner in the semiconductor and electronics materials supply chain.
